description: Create a censor job that processes a specific clip and bleeps / mutes profanity. Returns a jobId. Poll opus_get_censor_job_status until status is "CONCLUDED" (success) or "FAILED". Set `options.beepSound: true` to substitute a beep for censored words; default is to mute them.

clipId.description: Clip ID to censor (the curation suffix, e.g. "CU67da38").

projectId.description: Project ID containing the clip to censor.

name: opus_create_censor_job
